jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Supportability Decisions
jobs.description_text: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. About the team Supportability sits at the vital intersection of platform safety, regulatory trust and merchant growth. Our mission is to ensure legitimate businesses can seamlessly onboard and thrive on Stripe, while proactively safeguarding the financial ecosystem from bad actors and high-risk activity. The Supportability Decisions team is a newly forming pillar anchored in our Dublin office. In this role, you will be the foundational technical lead establishing this capability in Dublin. Our mission is to accelerate Stripe’s global expansion by building the canonical Supportability Decision Layer; a stateful distributed platform that provides unified, real-time, and explainable risk determinations to unlock fast, compliant merchant onboarding and payment method expansion worldwide. Doing this at scale requires solving high-stakes risk challenges with precision. Deceptive merchant activity, such as transaction laundering, introduces significant threats as bad actors actively adapt to mask illicit and unsupported activities behind legitimate storefronts. Rather than relying on rigid, fragmented controls that create unnecessary friction for good users, our team builds the intelligent decision systems that systematically separate legitimate businesses from adversarial behavior, enabling Stripe to grow safely and aggressively. jobs.title: Staff Offensive Security Engineer, Proactive threat
jobs.description_text: About the team The Proactive Threat team finds vulnerabilities and security weaknesses across Stripe's systems, applications, networks, and cloud infrastructure before adversaries do. We're a hybrid offensive function. We run penetration tests, emulate real-world threat actors in red team operations, and work closely with our defensive security teams to validate detection capabilities and improve Stripe's overall security posture. We are builders first. We build custom tooling, automation frameworks, and internal platforms that scale our offensive work and make our assessments repeatable and high-fidelity. Increasingly, that includes AI agents that find and validate vulnerabilities at a scale no human team could reach. We believe the best offensive security engineers are equal parts hacker and engineer. The team is distributed and works regularly with security, engineering, and product stakeholders across Stripe, including teams in Europe and Asia. What you'll do As a Staff Offensive Security Engineer on the Proactive Threat team, you'll set the technical direction for how Stripe tests itself the way a real adversary would. You'll be the team's most senior offensive practitioner. You'll stay deeply hands-on: you'll lead the hardest engagements yourself and write the tooling that makes everyone around you more effective. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Accounting Products
jobs.description_text: About the team Stripe’s Accounting Products team is building modern infrastructure for the Office of the CFO. Our vision is to give finance teams, and the agents that support them, one reconciled and explainable presentation of financial truth. Today, the data and context required to make accounting decisions are fragmented across billing systems, contracts, spreadsheets, general ledgers, and the minds of the people doing the work. Finance teams spend significant time reconstructing what happened, determining the appropriate accounting treatment, reconciling results, and gathering evidence. Giving an agent access to the underlying data is not enough: it also needs the business context, accounting policies, approved judgments, and guardrails required to act reliably. Revenue Recognition is our first major proof point. Stripe has a unique opportunity to help Billing and Metronome users turn complex revenue activity—including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, credits, and contract modifications—into accurate, explainable journal entries. Our ambition is for agents to take on the investigation, configuration, and repetitive work while accountants retain control over consequential judgments and approvals. Over time, we expect to expand into additional Office of the CFO workflows, and we are looking for a Staff Product Manager to help turn this vision into products that finance teams trust. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Custom Objects
jobs.description_text: About the team Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data. Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points. We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe. What you’ll do This is a product management opportunity for an early-stage product (private preview!), and you’ll be responsible for the entire product line: identifying use cases, product design, iterating quickly by partnering with early adopters, pricing, and more. You’ll also work very closely with multiple teams at Stripe to enable their products to be “custom object-ready.” Responsibilities Interact with customers and internal product teams daily so that you can validate product ideas, requirements, and prototypes Partner with engineering and design to ship functionality that delights users, strikes the right balance between impact a

We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm. Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users. At Stripe’s scale—$1.9 trillion in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, processed across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries. jobs.description_text: About the team The Batch Compute Experience team owns the platform that Stripe engineers use to build, run, debug and optimize Apache Spark jobs. Those jobs handle large-scale data processing for analytics, machine learning, finance and core product data pipelines. Hundreds of engineers and thousands of production jobs driving critical business processes, such as payouts and reconciliations, run on this platform. Today, diagnosing and tuning a job means reasoning by hand across scattered telemetry, configuration, query plans and application code. Our goal is to make Spark at Stripe fast to iterate, reliable by default, and self-optimizing, so engineers can focus on business logic instead of Spark internals. We're doing this through three connected efforts: Modernization : keeping Stripe's Spark runtime and dependency stack current, including Spark 3.5 → Spark 4, Scala 2.13 and Apache Iceberg. We're building automated upgrade and validation tools so that upgrading the whole fleet becomes routine and low-risk instead of a multi-year manual effort Agentic Spark and optimization : building trustworthy, AI-powered workflows that diagnose failed or underperforming jobs, recommend fixes based on evidence, and carry them safely into configuration changes, code PRs or escalations. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description_text: About The Role: Drivemode is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to turn vehicle telemetry and user behavior data into reliable insights that guide product improvement. This is a hands-on individual contributor role within Engineering, working closely with the Analytics Product Manager and Product and Engineering teams. You’ll work from a centrally governed, pseudonymized, preprocessed data layer (silver layer) in Snowflake, building the intermediate and analysis-ready models, dashboards, and analyses the company relies on. You’ll help translate business questions into well-defined problems and recommendations, especially around user behavior and UX improvements. Beyond delivering analyses, you’ll help establish a data-driven culture by proactively identifying opportunities, improving data quality and analytical capabilities, and working across organizational boundaries to turn insights into measurable product improvements.

jobs.title: Senior UX Researcher
jobs.description_text: About The Role: Drivemode is looking for a Senior UX Researcher to join our growing UX Research team. This is our third dedicated UX research hire, and a rare opportunity to shape our research function. You’ll partner closely with product managers, designers, and engineers at both Drivemode and Honda to bring clarity and confidence to design and product decisions. Your work will connect business strategy to user needs, enabling teams to move quickly without losing sight of what matters most. We’re looking for someone who brings both rigor and flexibility to their methods and is energized by ambiguous, complex problem spaces. At Drivemode, researchers are valued strategic partners. You’ll be expected to influence roadmaps, advocate for the user, and inspire the broader design culture with curiosity, precision, and empathy.

Current treatment technologies include Active Water Treatment Facilities (AWTFs), Saturated Rock Fill facilities (SRFs), Reverse Osmosis – High Density Sludge (RO-HDS) and Antiscalant Addition Facilities (AAFs) for calcite prevention. You will lead a team of technical professionals responsible for managing environmental risks and satisfying regulatory requirements associated with multiple planned and operating treatment facilities. To be successful, we are looking for someone with a strong technical background, outstanding critical thinking, and complex problem-solving abilities, who can make quick decisions in day-to-day operations. We require someone with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, who can lead and mentor a team, and who has experience with conflict resolution. jobs.description_text: The Work The Office Experience Team brings together Facilities, Administration, Reception, and Distribution to create welcoming, reliable, and well-supported workplaces. jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job The Associate, CFG Credit is responsible for supporting the underwriting team in document fulfillment from receipt of deal through to the funding stages by acting as a liaison between underwriting, origination, funding and partner/borrower. jobs.title: Bilingual Fraud Officer - Contract Position.
jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job The Fraud Officer conducts investigations to identify, assess, decision and report on activity that indicates an exposure to financial crimes. Ensures potential threats and investigations are evaluated, documented, managed and escalated by following standard operating procedures. jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job As part of a growing and dynamic Commercial Portfolio Management team, the Bilingual Senior Commercial Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management of an assigned group of lending partners and associated portfolio of mortgages, from funding through maturity. The Bilingual Senior Account Manager’s portfolio will be comprised of complex construction, renovation, and portfolio mortgages secured by all asset classes and ranging in size from $5.0 million to $50.0 million. Additional credit-related and administrative duties are also required such as reporting and pipeline management as well as networking with external business partners along with various staff within the Commercial department & other internal departments.

As well, networking with mortgage brokers, partners and other external third parties along with various staff within the Credit & Risk group & other internal departments.

jobs.description_text: The Work The Data Scientist, Growth leads the design, development, deployment, and operationalization of advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that support growth, customer experience, and commercial decision-making. The role translates ambiguous business problems into measurable data science solutions, with a focus on pricing, customer engagement, recommendation systems, experimentation, and model-driven decision support. The role works across the full analytical lifecycle, from problem framing and exploratory analysis through model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and production implementation. It also contributes to the modernization, migration, and scaling of machine learning assets and data workflows across cloud platforms and enterprise analytical environments.

jobs.description_text: EQ Bank is changing how Canadians experience banking, and how we serve and protect our customers is central to that mission. As Director, Product Management – Operations & Servicing, you will set the product vision for two critical areas: Care & Servicing (customer care tooling, agentic AI servicing, CRM, and front- and back-office operations) and Risk (fraud and AML systems and controls). You will lead a team of product leaders, owning domain strategy, prioritization, and executive representation while coaching your Leads to deliver measurable outcomes. You will also be the product leader for two of the most significant workstreams in the EQ × PCF integration, customer servicing and fraud/AML. Your work will directly shape how customers are served and protected as the business grows.

jobs.description_text: The Work The Product Manager, Deposits Portfolio develops and implements product strategies to drive customer engagement with the payments and spending portfolio, supports the development and launch of new products to market, optimizes existing processes, and improves the customer experience. The role requires deep understanding of the product construct, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to use data to identify opportunities to evolve the deposit portfolio. The Product Manager supports new projects from ideation through implementation, development, and launch, working with multidisciplinary teams and strategic partners.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager, Portfolio Management, Commercial Finance Group (CFG)
jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job As part of a growing and dynamic Commercial Portfolio Management team, the Senior Commercial Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management of an assigned group of lending partners and associated portfolio of mortgages, from funding through maturity. The Senior Account Manager’s portfolio will be comprised of complex construction, renovation, and portfolio mortgages secured by all asset classes and ranging in size from $5.0 million to $50.0 million. Participation in syndicated transactions of $150.0 million or more can also be expected. The Senior Account Manager will deliver superior customer service by understanding, and responding to, the needs of the client by way of underwriting renewals, assumptions, refinances, loan modifications, etc. in an effort to meet annual retention targets. jobs.title: Senior AML Advisory Specialist (18 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The AML Advisory team within the Compliance department is a Second Line of Defence function responsible for providing independent oversight, effective challenge and advice to first line business units as a subject matter expert on Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Terrorist Financing (AML/ATF), Sanctions Evasion (SE), and compliance-related matters. This position primarily assists the Senior Manager, AML Advisory, in the ongoing oversight, management and enhancement of Equitable Bank’s enterprise-wide AML/ATF and SE financial crimes program. The Senior Analyst, AML Advisory’s role is a multifaceted one. Responsibilities may include regulatory and policy guidance, risk assessment, change initiative reviews, AML/ATF/SE training and stakeholder engagement, ensuring AML/ATF/SE related policy and procedures are understood, maintained, and current. The role supports oversight and effective challenge to First Line businesses to support a comprehensive and effective Regulatory Compliance Management regime within the Bank and manage financial crimes, reputational and other operational risks. The environment is fast-paced and requires effective time management of multiple tasks and projects.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Commercial QA (12 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Analyst reports to and supports the Senior Manager, Credit Risk, with respect to the management of all aspects of Commercial(Including the Special assets management unit & Specialized finance) credit risk across the Bank. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for reviewing loan portfolios with the objective of maintaining high-quality lending strategies and the monitoring of risk mitigation strategies. A key function of the role is to assist in providing assurance to the Senior Management on the soundness of underwriting processes and account management routines associated with the portfolio. Another key aspect of the role is to assist in the determination of where Equitable may be exposed to credit or other key risks and identify possible mitigating strategies and/or actions that can be implemented to minimize or eliminate the risk. Developing internal relationships with credit stakeholders is critical to the role.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Operational Risk Management
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Analyst, Operational Risk Management supports the Bank's Operational Risk Management framework by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and reporting non-financial risks. The role partners with business units across the organization to evaluate operational risks and controls, conduct independent control testing, oversee issue remediation activities, and support the Business Continuity Management program. The position helps ensure risks related to people, processes, systems, and external events are appropriately managed and reported while promoting a strong risk management culture across the Bank.

jobs.title: Senior Application Analyst (12 Months contract)
jobs.description_text: The Senior Application Analyst supports the company’s financial and enterprise applications, including core financial applications. He/she acts as a technical lead and subject matter expert for a portfolio of complex applications, responsible for production support, administration, workflow development, testing, upgrades and documentation to meet business needs. Reporting to the Associate Director, Application Support, he/she works with business users, vendors and technical teams in a fast-paced environment, ensures incidents are triaged and resolved in a timely manner, meets regulatory and audit deadlines, and escalates risks.

The role establishes the Personal Banking approach to franchise value creation, including customer segmentation and lifetime value economics, joint value propositions and bundled offers, and channel strategy for customer growth. Working across Product, Marketing, Analytics, Loyalty, Digital and Operations, the Senior Director mobilizes cross-functional execution and is accountable for delivering the relationship deepening and franchise growth outcomes established through the annual plan.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, FP&A and Capital
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, FP&A and Capital leads enterprise FP&A forecasting, capital planning, and related financial analysis. The role integrates business and financial assumptions, earnings, balance sheet growth, Risk Weighted Assets (RWA), capital actions, and strategic priorities into a clear enterprise outlook and provides senior and executive management with decision-useful forecasts, scenario analysis, and recommendations. The Senior Manager partners closely with FP&A, Treasury, Risk, Accounting, and business leaders to coordinate forecast inputs, challenge assumptions, explain performance and outlook, and ensure capital implications are appropriately reflected across the Bank’s financial plans, while strengthening forecasting models, controls, processes, and team capability.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Java (Contract)
jobs.description_text: The work The Senior Software Engineer is an experienced, hands-on engineer within Digital Technology, responsible for designing, building, and supporting modern digital banking solutions. This role owns complex engineering work from design through production and contributes to technical decisions that help teams build secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable software. The Senior Software Engineer works collaboratively across teams, shares knowledge, supports other engineers, and contributes to continuously improving engineering practices and software delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (18 Month Contract)
jobs.description_text: The Senior Technical Program Manager (STPM) reports to the Director, Technical Program Management. The STPM owns end-to-end plan management and delivery execution for highly complex technical programs across EQ Bank's Digital Banking ecosystem, with a strong emphasis on measurable business value, customer outcomes, reliability, and usability. The STPM leads execution across multiple interdependent teams and domains, proactively surfaces technical and non-technical risks, establishes mitigation plans, manages complex dependencies, drives decisions, and enables alignment across Engineering, Product, Business, Enterprise partners, and third parties. The STPM applies company policies and Enterprise Change Management requirements while balancing governance with modern product and technology delivery practices. The STPM operates effectively where scope, ownership, or the delivery path is ambiguous. The role is expected to build strong cross-functional relationships, influence senior stakeholders without authority, resolve escalated delivery constraints, and provide clear executive-level visibility of program health, trade-offs, and decisions.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Infrastructure Solutions (12 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The Staff Engineer plays a key role within the Infrastructure Solutions team, defining infrastructure strategies and roadmaps with a strong emphasis on network engineering initiatives. This role will involve finalizing designs and technical implementations that align with the architecture established by the Enterprise Architecture function, ensuring optimal use of technology within the organization. The specialist will contribute to the development of policies, processes, and procedures for Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) and provide expert advice on technology utilization to enhance overall enterprise value. In addition to these responsibilities, the position will focus on creating robust network architectures and developing high-level designs that meet business requirements. This includes designing network topologies, selecting appropriate technologies, and producing detailed documentation. The specialist will collaborate with various teams, including Azure Cloud Operations and business unit infrastructure requirements, to ensure alignment with organizational objectives while supporting high-level infrastructure needs across the enterprise.

jobs.title: Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job The Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management is a senior member of the CRO’s leadership team and serves as the CRO and Deputy CRO’s primary partner on enterprise risk governance, leading the second-line ERM function and the continued development and operation of a forward-looking risk management program aligned with regulatory expectations and commensurate with EQ Bank’s size, scope and complexity. The VP, ERM will provide the vision and roadmap to further embed ERM across the organization, working closely with business leaders to strengthen risk management capabilities while providing independent oversight and effective challenge on strategic and business decisions. The role will oversee the Bank’s enterprise-wide view of risk, including its Board-approved Risk Appetite Framework, management and reporting of key risks, and reporting to the Board and Enterprise Risk Management Committee (ERMC), while supporting the CRO and Deputy CRO in interactions with OSFI and other regulatory stakeholders. The VP, ERM will also lead the risk management aspects of integration of PC Financial with EQ Bank and build a high-performing ERM team that is nimble and innovative, enabling EQ Bank to achieve its strategic objectives while operating within its risk appetite.

jobs.title: Senior Optical Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: Overview We are expanding our optomechanical capabilities, and the success of our projects depends on optical designs that are precise, manufacturable, and verified through rigorous analysis and testing. As a Senior Optical Design Engineer, you will own optical designs from concept through lab validation, turning requirements into lens designs and optical assemblies that perform reliably in the real world. This position is central to our mission of delivering cutting-edge free-space optical systems for space applications, and it will support successful pre-production runs and strong collaboration with our suppliers. This position reports to our Responsible Engineer, Optical Systems, and is based in our Toulouse, France office. Our working language is English.

jobs.title: Thermal Test and Modelling Engineer
jobs.description_text: What is the role: We are seeking a Thermal Engineer to own the thermal analysis and testing of our space products, such as sensors and actuators. The role centers on building thermal models and correlating them with test data, and on planning and running thermal test campaigns in house. It is a hands-on position: you will instrument and run tests yourself and use the results to improve both the design and our test infrastructure. This position is based in our Toulouse office.

jobs.description_text: TECHNOLOGY The Technology team builds end-to-end products and solutions that power our marketplace, delivering an incredible experience for customers globally. From understanding customer and partner needs to designing and testing innovative hypotheses, we create industry-leading experiences for luxury customers everywhere. THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Data Scientist to join our Data team at FARFETCH, with a focus on evolving our in-house Experimentation Platform and its custom-built Statistical Engine. Our Experimentation Platform enables teams across FARFETCH to run A/B tests, measure the impact of product changes, and make data-driven decisions at scale. At its core, our Python-based Statistical Engine processes experiment results and powers automated, self-service analytics. jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.description_text: FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise. Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments . The Network Security Engineer is responsible for Network Security software development, including collaborating on developing requirements, writing technical specifications, designing, coding, and working with a team on testing and deployment. This is a key, hands-on software development position that will work closely with other team members to develop new features and functions.
